letters.text: Palm Coast, Fl I am pleased to provide this letter of recommendation for Freeland Marketing and its owner, Kevin. When I first began working with Freeland Marketing, my wood carving business was operating as a small hobby out of my garage. Today, I run a fully operational wood shop creating custom hand-carved pieces featuring tiki designs and Florida wildlife themes. Over the past year alone, my business has grown tenfold, and I credit much of that success to the strategic marketing, organization, and guidance provided by Freeland Marketing. Freeland Marketing utilizes Facebook and Instagram advertising to reach hundreds of thousands of people throughout Florida, dramatically increasing my visibility and customer base. Their marketing strategy has consistently generated strong engagement and high-quality leads, allowing my business to expand at a pace I had never imagined possible. What truly sets this company apart is their hands-on involvement and genuine commitment to client success. Kevin has personally visited my workshop on multiple occasions to photograph and film my artwork—not only at my home shop but also at carefully selected locations around town—to ensure the highest-quality presentation of my work online. That level of dedication and attention to detail speaks volumes about their professionalism. In addition to marketing, Freeland Marketing has helped me organize and optimize my business operations. From improving scheduling systems to offering professional guidance on business structure, they have gone far beyond traditional marketing services. Kevin has also recommended trusted professionals and resources, including a tax representative, warehouse opportunities, and T-shirt printing companies, all of which have contributed to my company’s overall growth and stability. Freeland Marketing worked with me on pricing when I was just getting started, demonstrating their willingness to invest in my potential. As my business grew, I was able to transition to their standard monthly rate—something that would not have been possible without their initial support and effective marketing strategy. From my experience, Freeland Marketing has no interest other than supporting your business and helping you grow. Their professionalism, integrity, and dedication make them an outstanding marketing partner. I highly recommend Freeland Marketing to any business owner looking to elevate their brand, expand their reach, and achieve meaningful growth. Sincerely, Joe Miller Owner Joe Tiki Custom Wood Carving

letters.text: Subject: Website Recommendation I personally recommend Kevin Freeland for website development and optimization work. Before working with Kevin, my website was not accurately communicating the depth of my work, the transformation I provide for families, or the premium level of support my company offers. While I knew the outcomes we create, translating that clearly and compellingly online was a challenge. Kevin quickly identified the gaps and helped restructure the messaging in a way that was both strategic and aligned with my vision. He not only improved the website itself, but also strengthened the way my services are communicated from a sales and marketing standpoint. The phrasing throughout the site is far more compelling, clearer for parents to understand, and better positioned to attract the families I am best equipped to support. He also incorporated stronger SEO strategy and language so the right people can actually find my business online rather than simply increasing generic traffic. That level of intentionality mattered to me. What stood out most was his efficiency and execution. I sent him documentation about my company, and within two days the site was already about 90% complete with only minor corrections remaining. He understood the vision quickly, streamlined the process, and translated complex ideas into a polished and professional online presence. If you desire someone who is strategic, collaborative, responsive, and highly skilled at clarifying a brand and strengthening its online presence, I highly recommend connecting with Kevin. Sasha Gooray Founder, The Real You Joyful Learning Center
